title: TCS Sydney Marathon 2026 course page
claims: The 2026 TCS Sydney Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 30 August 2026 over 42.195 km and is described as a World Athletics Platinum Label marathon.
The course starts on Miller Street in North Sydney and finishes at the Sydney Opera House Forecourt.
The 2026 edition is described as the newest Abbott World Marathon Major and expects 35,000 runners.
Runners are assigned to three start groups and three assembly areas (orange, red and green).
Start Group 1 starts from 6:31 am, Start Group 2 from 7:03 am and Start Group 3 from 7:41 am, as rolling starts.
The start line is open from 6:30 am to 8:15 am, a 1-hour-45-minute window.
The official cut-off is 7 hours 0 minutes, listed as 3:15 pm, with a minimum pace of 10 minutes per kilometre.
The page lists net elevation gain of 317 metres and net elevation loss of 400 metres.
Powerade Mountain Blast is at drink stations at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 km and at the finish recovery area.
GU Energy Gels are available at the 20 km and 30 km drink stations, are limited and not guaranteed, and runners are advised to carry their own.
Water is available at all drink stations.
Portable toilets are at each drink station.
A marathon-only refreshment station is located after the finish line in the Marathon Recovery Zone.
Pacers wear red TCS Sydney Marathon Pace Team singlets, run to chip time and aim for no more than 30 seconds variation at halfway.
The page lists cut-off and redirection points from the start line through 32.5 km, including a tail collection vehicle at 28.3 km.
The page links to a course map and a course elevation map.
Bib collection takes place at the TCS Sydney Marathon Running Show.
